_readme: Curated seed for the nutrition system. Compact rows, expanded by scripts/import-foods.mjs. Numbers are per 100 g (or per 100 ml for liquids). m = [kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g, sugar_g, sodium_mg]. mi = [iron_mg, calcium_mg, magnesium_mg, potassium_mg, zinc_mg, iodine_mcg, selenium_mcg, folate_mcg, b12_mcg, vitD_mcg, vitA_mcg, vitC_mg]. h = [household_label, grams_per_unit, kind]  kind: count|measure|liquid. cat: protein|legumes|dairy|grain|vegetable|fruit|nuts|oils|processed. reg: indian|western|mediterranean|east_asian|middle_eastern|latin|universal.
